kids_evidence: Not a children's app. Spec user: 'An adult who manages ongoing care: two or more regular medicines...' (MyHealth.md:52). store/apps/MyHealth.json primary_category = HEALTH_AND_FITNESS. No Kids or Families field. This is a sensitive health context.

banner.where: lib/screens/timeline/timeline_screen.dart:145 (TimelineScreen, last item of the list, gated by AdsSlot at lib/main.dart:131, :154)

interstitial.why: There is no AglAds.onTransition in lib/ (grep). Keep it absent. This is a personal medical record, and the spec says 'no interstitial' (MyHealth.md:211).

native.why: This is a health context. The founder rule allows native only in browse/discovery lists, never in sensitive data screens. The Timeline, medicines, labs, readings and care team are all health data. The only non-sensitive browse list is ExerciseLibraryScreen (lib/screens/activity/exercise_screens.dart:49-62, for-loop at :53 over a bundled catalogue of 40 exercises, lib/record/exercise_catalog.dart). But spec F2 (MyHealth.md:211, :338) limits ads to one Timeline banner, and it is still open. I am not sure, so use=false. If the founder wants one native, the exercise library is the only acceptable place: one native after the 10th exercise, small template.

rewarded.why: Nothing honest to reward, and this is a health context. There is no quota, premium tier or IAP. The only 'limit' matches are API query parameters (lib/net/nppes.dart:66, lib/brief/recalls.dart:73).

blockers: Founder question F2 (keep ads in a medical-record app) is open (MyHealth.md:338). The default if unanswered is the inline Timeline banner only.

Age-rating answers: there is no store/ratings/MyHealth.json, so deliver_metadata.py:48 falls back to store/ratings/default.json, whose line 16 is "advertising": false, and passes it to Apple at deliver_metadata.py:75. This app does show banners. store-compliance should add store/ratings/MyHealth.json with advertising: true.

agl_ads is locked in pubspec.lock to 7b3c98e (resolved-ref, line 17), which does not contain agl-manifest cb21ee5 (checked with `git merge-base --is-ancestor cb21ee5 7b3c98e`). Run `flutter pub upgrade agl_ads` before using AglNativeAd / AglAds.showRewarded.
